Event.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for individual marine salp sampling events.

Sample ID.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers assigned to individual marine salp sampling events.

Expedition.description: Unique alphanumeric codes identifying specific marine research expeditions.

Date/Time.description: Sampling date and time recorded in year-month-day hour-minute-second format.

Year sampl.description: Sampling year recorded as an integer between 2004 and 2021.

Vessel.description: Research vessel names conducting marine salp sampling expeditions.

Station.description: Station identifiers for marine salp sampling locations and research cruises.

Gear.description: Type of plankton sampling gear used during marine salp collection.

Depth water.description: Water depth in meters where marine salp samples were collected.

Depth water_2.description: Water depth in meters at the second sampling location.

Location.description: Geographic regions where marine salp samples were collected.

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinates in decimal degrees for marine sampling locations.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinates in decimal degrees for marine sampling locations.

Species UID.description: Scientific names of marine salp species observed during sampling.

Species UID (Semantic URI).description: Unique Marine Species Identifier URIs from the World Register of Marine Species.

Species UID (URI).description: Uniform Resource Identifiers linking to specific marine salp species taxonomic records.

Order.description: Taxonomic order classification for marine salp species, primarily Salpida and Pyrosomida.

Size.description: Salp specimen size measurements in millimeters ranging from 10.2 to 1000.0.

Tissue descriptor.description: Specifies the salp tissue portion sampled, such as whole, tunic, or stomach.

Method comm.description: Sampling method codes, primarily FD with occasional OD entries.

No spec.description: Number of salp species identified per sampling event.

Life stage.description: Salp life stage classification using codes O and B.

Con m.description: Concentration of carbon in milligrams per cubic meter.

Sample dm.description: Dry mass of salp samples measured in milligrams.

Mass_2.description: Salp specimen mass measurements in milligrams ranging from 59.3 to 472.6.

Ash m.description: Ash mass measured in milligrams per cubic meter.

afdm.description: AFDM measures ash-free dry mass in milligrams per sample.

afdm_2.description: AFDM 2 measurements in milligrams per cubic meter.

C/dm.description: Carbon content per cubic decimeter measured in milligrams.

N/dm.description: Salp abundance measured in individuals per cubic decimeter.

H/dm.description: Ratio of height to dry mass for marine salp specimens.

C/N.description: Carbon to nitrogen ratio measured in marine salp samples.

C/N_2.description: Carbon to nitrogen molar ratio measured in marine salp samples.

C/H.description: Carbon to hydrogen ratio values measured in marine salp samples.

H/C.description: Hydrogen to carbon ratio probability scores ranging from 0.0806 to 0.7161.

Comment.description: Biochemical composition ratios of carbon, nitrogen, and hydrogen in salp samples.

H.description: Salinity measurements in practical salinity units ranging from 0.45 to 6.12.

H2O res.description: H2O res measures water content in salp samples.

Sum.description: Total salp biomass or abundance measured in unspecified units.

Sum_2.description: Sum of biochemical metric values ranging from 35.75 to 108.84.

Elevation.description: Elevation values in meters below sea level range from -5371.0 to -3796.0.

961147.description: Marine salp sampling data from 2004 to 2021, including species, location, and biochemical metrics.

description: Earth and environmental science data spanning 2004 to 2021 across 961,147 tables.
